question: Which is the last surah of the Quran in the standard order of the Mushaf?
explanation: An-Nas, with 6 verses, is the 114th and last surah.

question: Which surah with only 3 verses is known as the shortest surah by wording?
explanation: Al-Kawthar has 3 verses and is the shortest surah by number of words.

question: In which blessed night was the Quran first revealed?
explanation: The Quran began to be revealed in the Night of Power in the month of Ramadan.

question: Under which caliph was the Quran first collected into a single written volume?
explanation: The Quran was first compiled into one copy in the time of Abu Bakr.

question: Under which caliph were standard copies of the Quran made and sent to the main Muslim cities?
explanation: Uthman had copies made from the compiled text and sent them to the major centres.

question: Which is the second surah of the Quran?
explanation: Al-Baqarah follows Al-Fatihah and is the longest surah.

question: Which basic belief does Surah Al-Ikhlas emphasise?
explanation: Al-Ikhlas declares that God is One, Eternal, and without child or equal.

question: Which surah, recited in every unit of prayer, is called 'The Opening of the Book'?
explanation: Al-Fatihah is recited in every unit of the prayer.

question: In which surah is Ayat al-Kursi (verse 255) found?
explanation: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.

question: How many parts (juz') is the Quran divided into?
explanation: The Quran is divided into 30 equal parts called juz'.

question: Which prophet has a surah named after him among the following?
explanation: Surah Yunus is the 10th surah; the other three prophets have no surah named after them.

question: How many verses does Surah Al-Fatihah have?
explanation: Al-Fatihah consists of seven verses.

question: Which angel brought revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
explanation: Jibril is the angel entrusted with delivering revelation.

question: The longest verse of the Quran, the verse on debt contracts, is in which surah?
explanation: The verse on documenting debts is the longest verse of the Quran.

question: Which two surahs at the end of the Quran teach seeking refuge in God?
explanation: Al-Falaq and An-Nas are called al-Mu'awwidhatayn, the two surahs of refuge.

question: Which surah tells a single story and calls it 'the best of stories'?
explanation: Surah Yusuf recounts the story of Prophet Yusuf from beginning to end.

question: What are the surahs revealed in Mecca before the Hijrah called?
explanation: Surahs revealed before the Hijrah are called Makki; those after are called Madani.

question: What are the surahs revealed after the Hijrah called?
explanation: Madani surahs were revealed in Medina after the Hijrah.

question: Which surah is named after the bee and speaks of its inspiration and the healing it provides?
explanation: An-Nahl means 'the bee'.

question: In which surah does a second Bismillah appear inside the text itself (verse 30)?
explanation: The letter of Sulayman to the Queen of Sheba begins with 'In the name of God' in verse 30.

question: Which companion is the only one mentioned by name in the Quran?
explanation: Zayd ibn Harithah is the only companion named in the Quran.

question: According to Surah Al-Qadr, the Night of Power is better than what?
explanation: Surah Al-Qadr says the Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

question: In which surah is the story of the People of the Cave told?
explanation: Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the youth who slept in the cave.

question: Which surah describes people on the Day of Judgement as 'scattered moths'?
explanation: Al-Qari'ah describes the terrors of the Day of Judgement.

question: Which surah begins by swearing by time and names the qualities of the believers who are not at loss?
explanation: Al-'Asr is only three verses long and sums up the way to success.

question: Which surah tells how Abraha's army that came to destroy the Kaaba was destroyed?
explanation: Al-Fil recounts the Year of the Elephant.

question: Which surah opens by saying angels are made messengers with two, three or four wings?
explanation: The first verse of Surah Fatir mentions angels with wings in twos, threes and fours.

question: Which wise man in the Quran advises his son not to associate partners with God and to pray?
explanation: Surah Luqman records the advice of Luqman to his son.

question: In which surah is 'Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?' repeated 31 times?
explanation: Surah Ar-Rahman repeats this refrain 31 times.

question: Which surah exposes the hypocrites for their lying and double standards?
explanation: Al-Munafiqun describes the hypocrites of Medina.

question: Which surah begins by addressing the Prophet as 'You who are wrapped up' and tells him to rise and warn?
explanation: Al-Muddaththir begins with 'O you who is covered, arise and warn'.

question: Which surah discusses the Battle of Uhud and the test of the believers?
explanation: Surah Al Imran contains the account of Uhud.

question: Which surah answers those who mocked the Prophet as 'cut off' by saying the one cut off is the one who hates him?
explanation: Al-Kawthar declares that the one who hates the Prophet is the one cut off.

question: Which surah says the earth will be shaken with a mighty quake and will bring out its burdens?
explanation: Az-Zalzalah describes the Day of Judgement quake.

question: Which surah explains the shares of inheritance in the most detail?
explanation: An-Nisa sets out the Islamic rules of inheritance.

question: In which surah are the three companions who stayed behind from the Tabuk expedition and were forgiven mentioned?
explanation: At-Tawbah mentions the three who repented sincerely and were forgiven.

question: Which surah is named 'Iron' and speaks of its great strength and benefits?
explanation: Al-Hadid says God sent down iron, in which is great might and benefits.

question: Which surah divides people on the Day of Judgement into three groups according to their deeds?
explanation: Al-Waqi'ah describes the companions of the right, of the left, and the foremost.

question: Which surah announces the ruin of Abu Lahab, the Prophet's enemy?
explanation: Al-Masad (also Tabbat) says the hands of Abu Lahab will perish.

question: How many surahs begin with the letters Ha-Mim (the 'Hawamim' surahs)?
explanation: There are seven Ha-Mim surahs from Ghafir to Al-Ahqaf.

question: How many verses does Surah Yusuf have?
explanation: Surah Yusuf has 111 verses.

question: Which surah describes the believers' patience during the Battle of the Trench against the allied armies?
explanation: Al-Ahzab recounts the siege of Medina by the confederate armies.

question: Which surah says you will find no change in God's way (sunnatullah)?
explanation: Fatir 43 states that you will never find any change in God's way.

question: Which surah gives rulings about the spoils of the Battle of Badr and the ransom of prisoners?
explanation: Al-Anfal deals with the spoils of war after Badr.

question: Which surah tells the story of the People of the Trench, where believers were thrown into fire?
explanation: Al-Buruj condemns those who burned the believers in trenches.

question: In which surah is the Prophet exonerated of the slander against Aisha, mother of the believers?
explanation: Surah An-Nur announces the innocence of Aisha.

question: What name does the Quran give to the day of Badr, the day the criterion between truth and falsehood was shown?
explanation: The day of Badr is called Yawm al-Furqan, the day of discrimination.

question: What is the longest surah of the Quran?
explanation: Al-Baqarah has 286 verses and is the longest surah.

question: How many surahs does the Quran have in total?
explanation: The Mushaf has 114 surahs, from Al-Fatihah to An-Nas.

question: Which surah does not begin with the Basmalah?
explanation: At-Tawbah is the only surah that does not start with the Basmalah.

question: From which surah were the first verses revealed to the Prophet?
explanation: The first five verses of Al-'Alaq begin with 'Read'.

question: Which surah has a name meaning 'the spider'?
explanation: Verse 41 compares those who take protectors besides God to a spider's house.

question: Which surah has a name meaning 'the ant'?
explanation: In verse 18 an ant warns its colony about Sulayman's army.

question: Which bird brought Prophet Sulayman news of the Queen of Sheba?
explanation: The hoopoe reported its discovery of the land of Sheba to Sulayman.

question: How does Surah Al-Muzzammil say the Quran should be recited?
explanation: The Quran says to recite it with measured recitation.

question: What is the complete recitation of the Quran from beginning to end called?
explanation: Completing a reading of the whole Quran is called a khatm.

question: What is a person who has memorised the entire Quran called?
explanation: One who has memorised the whole Quran is a hafiz.

question: What science teaches the correct pronunciation rules for reciting the Quran?
explanation: Tajwid teaches the rules of correct and beautiful recitation.

question: What is the science of explaining the meaning of the Quran's verses called?
explanation: Tafsir is the explanation of the meanings and rulings of the Quran.

question: Over roughly how many years was the Quran revealed?
explanation: The revelation lasted about 23 years, from the start of the mission until the Prophet's passing.

question: In which surah does Isa (Jesus) give the glad tidings of a messenger named 'Ahmad' who would come after him?
explanation: In verse 6 Isa says he brings glad tidings of a messenger whose name is Ahmad.

question: Which surah begins by swearing by the fig and the olive?
explanation: Surah At-Tin begins 'By the fig and the olive'.

question: Which surah begins by swearing by the sun and its brightness?
explanation: Surah Ash-Shams begins with an oath by the sun and its morning brightness.

question: Which surah begins by swearing by the morning brightness?
explanation: Ad-Duha begins with an oath by the forenoon.

question: Which surah begins 'Nun. By the pen and what they write'?
explanation: Al-Qalam begins with an oath by the pen and what is written with it.

question: In which surah is the verse 'You have your religion and I have mine' found?
explanation: The last verse of Al-Kafirun sets out freedom of belief and separation from idolatry.

question: In which surah is the verse 'He neither begot nor was begotten' found?
explanation: Verse 3 of Al-Ikhlas denies that God has a child or a parent.

question: Which surah begins 'When the help of God and victory come'?
explanation: An-Nasr announces God's help and victory, understood as the conquest of Mecca.

question: Which prophet's name appears most often in the Quran?
source: Count of prophets' names in the Quran
explanation: Musa and his story are mentioned more than any other prophet.

question: Which is the only month named in the Quran?
explanation: Ramadan is the only month mentioned by name, as the month in which the Quran was revealed.

question: In which surah is fasting prescribed for the believers?
explanation: Verse 183 says that fasting was prescribed for the believers as for those before them.

question: In which surah are believers told to hold firmly to the rope of God together?
explanation: Verse 103 of Al Imran calls Muslims to hold fast together to God's rope.

question: What are Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas called together?
explanation: They are called the two surahs of seeking refuge.

question: What are Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al Imran called together?
explanation: They are known together as 'the two radiant ones'.

question: According to the preferred view, which was the first surah revealed in Medina after the Hijrah?
explanation: Books on the Quranic sciences list Al-Baqarah as the first Medinan surah.

question: Which of the following surahs is Madani?
explanation: An-Nisa was revealed in Medina; the other three are Makki.

question: Which of the following surahs is Makki?
explanation: Al-Kahf was revealed in Mecca; the other three are Madani.

question: In which surah is the verse 'God is the Light of the heavens and the earth' found?
explanation: Verse 35 of An-Nur is known as the Verse of Light.

question: What is the number of Surah Al-Mulk in the Mushaf?
explanation: Al-Mulk is the 67th surah and has 30 verses.

question: In which surah is the verse 'The believers are but brothers' found?
explanation: Verse 10 of Al-Hujurat states that believers are brothers and calls for reconciliation.

question: How many verses does Surah Ya-Sin have?
explanation: Surah Ya-Sin has 83 verses.

question: Which surah is the second longest in the Quran by number of verses?
explanation: After Al-Baqarah comes Ash-Shu'ara with 227 verses; Al Imran has 200.

question: In which surah are believers told to leave trade and hurry to remember God when called to prayer?
explanation: Verse 9 of Al-Jumu'ah tells believers to leave business and go to the remembrance of God.

question: In which surah is 'This day I have perfected your religion for you' found?
explanation: Verse 3 of Al-Ma'idah announces the perfection of the religion and the completion of God's favour.

question: Which surah begins with the Night Journey from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque?
explanation: Al-Isra begins with 'Glory to Him who took His servant by night'.

question: In which surah is the Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary (Sidrat al-Muntaha) mentioned?
explanation: Verse 14 of An-Najm mentions Sidrat al-Muntaha.

question: How many verses does Surah Al-Qadr have?
explanation: Surah Al-Qadr consists of five verses.

question: In which surah is the prayer 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge' found?
explanation: Verse 114 of Ta-Ha teaches the prayer 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge'.

question: In which surah is 'You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help' found?
explanation: Verse 5 of Al-Fatihah declares that worship and help are for God alone.

question: Which is the first surah after Al-Fatihah to begin with the disjointed letters Alif-Lam-Mim?
explanation: Al-Baqarah begins with Alif-Lam-Mim.

question: Which name of the Quran means 'the criterion that separates truth from falsehood'?
explanation: Al-Furqan is one of the Quran's names and also the title of a surah.

question: In which surah is the instruction to call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good counsel found?
explanation: Verse 125 of An-Nahl sets out the method of inviting with wisdom and good counsel.

question: In which surah is the Prophet described as being of 'a great moral character'?
explanation: Al-Qalam 4: 'And indeed, you are of a great moral character.'

question: In which surah is the Messenger of God called 'an excellent example'?
explanation: Al-Ahzab 21 describes the Messenger of God as an excellent model.

question: In which surah is the Prophet described as sent only as a mercy to the worlds?
explanation: Al-Anbiya 107 says the Prophet was sent as a mercy to all the worlds.

question: In which surah was Ibrahim told to proclaim the Hajj to the people?
explanation: Al-Hajj 27 commands Ibrahim to announce the pilgrimage to people.

question: In which surah does it say the first house established for mankind is the one at Bakkah (Mecca)?
explanation: Al Imran 96 says the first house of worship set up for people is the blessed Kaaba.
